h2: NDT auditing services and compliance audit preparation
html:
Searches for NDT auditing services come from two directions. NDT companies want their own program audited before a client, registrar or owner does it, and buyers of NDT want their suppliers audited before work is awarded. Both need the same thing: an ASNT NDT Level III who knows what an auditor will ask to see and checks it against the evidence, not against what the manual promises.

Compliance audit preparation for NDT companies

Compliance audit preparation starts with the documents and ends with the records. A typical internal audit covers:

  • the written practice against the current edition of SNT-TC-1A or CP-189, and against each client's specification;
  • a sample of personnel certification files: training and experience hours, examination papers and grades, vision examinations, signatures and expiry dates;
  • procedures and technique sheets against the codes cited on recent jobs;
  • a sample of recent reports, traced back to the procedure, the instrument and its calibration, and the technician's certificate on the day of the work;
  • equipment calibration and daily verification records;
  • corrective actions from earlier audits, and whether they were closed with evidence.

Findings come back graded by risk, each with its fix, so gaps are closed before the external audit rather than explained during it. If records are the recurring problem, certification records software keeps them current between audits.

Supplier audit and NDT audit oversight for buyers

Owners, EPC contractors and fabricators that subcontract NDT can use the same checks as a supplier audit before approving a vendor, and as ongoing NDT audit oversight during a project: witnessing a sample of examinations, re-reviewing a sample of radiographs or UT data, and checking that the people on site hold the certificates listed in the bid. The subcontractor approval audits page covers both sides of that relationship.

Who signs the audit

Audits are led by an ASNT NDT Level III. Where an audit touches an API inspection programme, the review covers the NDE side only; the owner's Authorized Inspector stays inspector of record, and engineering assessments stay with the owner's engineer.

Related consulting

Audit findings usually lead to a written practice review and revision or to new procedures. For a standing arrangement, see NDT program management. To book an audit, request a confidential discussion.
